caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cupboard with an upper shelf section and a lower storage compartment. The cupboard is predominantly brown, showing the natural grain and texture of the wood. The top half consists of three horizontal shelves supported by side panels that feature a curved, scalloped design. The back panel behind the shelves is made up of vertically arranged wooden planks. Below the shelves, there is a flat surface that serves as a countertop. The lower section contains a storage compartment with two doors, each door consisting of a rectangular frame with a recessed center panel; one door has visible hinges on the left and the other has a metal handle on the right. The bottom edge of the cupboard has a decorative cut-out design, and the cupboard sits flush on the ground. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Hutch Dresser
